voice.summary: Sounds like a helpful neighbour with a ruler and a calculator: light, accurate and not afraid of a number. Examples are everyday, like cups and kilometres.
dos: Show the formula result with its units
donts: No technical jargon like SI base unit
Never make users do the maths

boilerplate: Metrolane is a pocket unit converter covering length, mass, temperature, volume and speed, with instant two-way conversion and a list of recent results.
